g.text: FH-PowerBox Node (Power Rails) — Complete Fritzing Wiring & Schematic
GPIO / SPI / I2C / PWM / ADC Signals
1. Redesigned Oct 28, 2026 (Power Rails, replaces archived Lights+Fan): 3x 1-ch 5V Relays switch 5V power (NO contact, fail-dark) to FH-HVAC, FH-FireAlarm, and FH-Door.
2. GPIO Map: GPIO 25 -> Rail 1 (FH-HVAC), GPIO 26 -> Rail 2 (FH-FireAlarm), GPIO 27 -> Rail 3 (FH-Door). All rails boot OFF until commanded ON by PLC/SCADA.
3. 5V-Pin Method: Relay COM fed from PowerBox 5V/VIN rail; NO feeds downstream ESP32 5V/VIN pin directly (downstream USB must be UNPLUGGED). Common GND shared across all nodes.
